calendar.note: Synthetic weekday calendar, NOT official MOE terms or Singapore public holidays. Add school closures and overrides before treating long-horizon outputs as forecasts.

staff.supervision: Operator needed for preparation, transfer, recovery and post-cleaning; continuous technician attendance is NOT assumed.

assumptions: No extra office robots: the 48 floor robots also cover selected office floors.
Two operators per school are a modeling resource allocation, not observed total cleaner headcount. Other cleaning staff and their work are outside this first model.
Four toilet blocks per school are pilot coverage, not every toilet in a school.
Floor robots assume automated docking and sufficient onboard water for scheduled work; daytime preflight is required.
Night lift access is simulated with one shared lift per school, not a live lift command or validated safety arrangement.
Probability rates, dimensions, speeds and consumptions are tunable illustrative values, not measured vendor reliability.
Robot coverage excludes bowls or fixtures outside modeled capability and all other complementary manual duties.

timetable.note: Illustrative timetable, not an actual MOE school timetable.
